```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
is_abs_path <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  if (is.na(p) || !nzchar(p)) return(FALSE)
  grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[\\/])", p)
}

find_git_root <- function(start = getwd(), max_up = 10) {
  p <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in 0:max_up) {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(p, ".git"))) return(p)
    up <- normalizePath(file.path(p, ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    if (identical(up, p)) break
    p <- up
  }
  ws <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_WORKSPACE", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(ws) && dir.exists(ws)) return(normalizePath(ws, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

git_root <- find_git_root()

resolve_from_root <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  if (is.na(p) || !nzchar(p) || p %in% c("NA","NULL")) return(NA_character_)
  if (is_abs_path(p)) return(p)
  file.path(git_root, p)
}

to_wgs84 <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(crs(x))) return(x)
  out <- try(terra::project(x, "EPSG:4326"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) x else out
}

safe_minmax <- function(r) {
  mm <- try(terra::minmax(r), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(mm, "try-error") || any(!is.finite(mm))) return(c(0, 1))
  rng <- c(mm[1,1], mm[2,1])
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || diff(rng) == 0) c(rng[1], rng[1] + 1) else rng
}

make_pal <- function(r) {
  leaflet::colorNumeric("viridis", domain = safe_minmax(r), na.color = "transparent")
}

# Robust NetCDF variable loader for terra
load_nc_var <- function(nc_path, var) {
  if (is.na(nc_path) || !file.exists(nc_path)) return(NULL)

  r1 <- try(terra::rast(nc_path, subds = var), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(r1, "try-error")) return(r1)

  r2 <- try(terra::rast(paste0("NETCDF:", nc_path, ":", var)), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(r2, "try-error")) return(r2)

  s <- try(terra::sds(nc_path), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(s, "try-error")) {
    nms <- names(s)
    ii <- which(tolower(nms) == tolower(var) | grepl(var, nms, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (length(ii) > 0) {
      r3 <- try(terra::rast(s[[ii[1]]]), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(r3, "try-error")) return(r3)
    }
  }

  NULL
}

load_haz <- function(row) {
  if (!is.na(row$haz_nc) && file.exists(row$haz_nc)) {
    hs0 <- load_nc_var(row$haz_nc, "Hs0")
    pr  <- load_nc_var(row$haz_nc, "Pr")
    if (!is.null(hs0) && !is.null(pr)) return(list(hs0 = hs0, pr = pr))
  }
  hs0 <- if (!is.na(row$haz_hs0_tif) && file.exists(row$haz_hs0_tif)) terra::rast(row$haz_hs0_tif) else NULL
  pr  <- if (!is.na(row$haz_pr_tif)  && file.exists(row$haz_pr_tif))  terra::rast(row$haz_pr_tif)  else NULL
  list(hs0 = hs0, pr = pr)
}
```

```{r load-index}
outdir <- params$outdir
idx_file <- file.path(git_root, outdir, "index.csv")

if (!file.exists(idx_file)) {
  cat("<h2>No outputs yet</h2>\n")
  cat("<p><code>", idx_file, "</code> not found. Run the workflow (or wait for the next schedule) and refresh.</p>\n", sep="")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

idx <- read.csv(idx_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
idx <- idx[idx$status == "ok", , drop = FALSE]
idx <- head(idx, params$max_storms)

if (nrow(idx) == 0) {
  cat("<h2>No successful storms in index</h2>\n")
  cat("<p>The workflow ran, but did not produce any successful storm outputs.</p>\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

# Coerce path columns to character (read.csv may infer logical when all NA)
path_cols <- intersect(c("gpkg","haz_nc","haz_hs0_tif","haz_pr_tif"), names(idx))
for (cc in path_cols) {
  idx[[cc]] <- as.character(idx[[cc]])
  idx[[cc]] <- vapply(idx[[cc]], resolve_from_root, character(1))
}

idx
```

```{=html}
<!-- Leaflet widgets inside Bootstrap {.tabset} often render blank because the map div is hidden at first.
     Triggering a window resize when a tab is shown forces Leaflet to redraw. -->
<script>
(function(){
  function triggerResize(){ try { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); } catch(e) {} }
  function onShown(){ setTimeout(triggerResize, 60); setTimeout(triggerResize, 250); }
  if (window.jQuery) {
    window.jQuery(document).on('shown.bs.tab', 'a[data-toggle="tab"]', onShown);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){ setTimeout(triggerResize, 200); });
})();
</script>
```

## Storm maps {.tabset}

```{r maps, results='asis'}
for (k in seq_len(nrow(idx))) {
  row <- idx[k, ]
  cat("\n\n### ", row$name, " (", row$TCid, ")\n\n", sep = "")

  tryCatch({
    if (is.na(row$gpkg) || !file.exists(row$gpkg)) {
      cat("*Track file missing:* ", row$gpkg, "\n\n", sep = "")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    TC <- terra::vect(row$gpkg)

    haz <- load_haz(row)
    hs0 <- haz$hs0
    pr  <- haz$pr

    if (is.null(hs0) || is.null(pr)) {
      cat("*Hazard rasters not found for this storm.*\n\n")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    # Choose representative layers
    hs0_by_t <- as.numeric(terra::global(hs0, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[,1])
    pr_by_t  <- as.numeric(terra::global(pr,  "min", na.rm = TRUE)[,1])
    hs0_peak_i <- if (all(is.na(hs0_by_t))) 1 else which.max(hs0_by_t)
    pr_min_i   <- if (all(is.na(pr_by_t)))  1 else which.min(pr_by_t)

    hs0_peak <- hs0[[hs0_peak_i]]
    pr_min   <- pr[[pr_min_i]]

    # Over-time aggregates
    hs0_max  <- terra::app(hs0, fun = max, na.rm = TRUE)
    pr_min_s <- terra::app(pr,  fun = min, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Project to EPSG:4326 for Leaflet
    TC_ll        <- to_wgs84(TC)
    hs0_peak_ll  <- to_wgs84(hs0_peak)
    hs0_max_ll   <- to_wgs84(hs0_max)
    pr_min_ll    <- to_wgs84(pr_min)
    pr_min_s_ll  <- to_wgs84(pr_min_s)

    pal_hs0p <- make_pal(hs0_peak_ll)
    pal_hs0m <- make_pal(hs0_max_ll)
    pal_prp  <- make_pal(pr_min_ll)
    pal_prm  <- make_pal(pr_min_s_ll)

    m <- leaflet(height = 650) |>
      addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
      addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") |>
      addPolylines(
        data = TC_ll[TC_ll$DATASET == "track", ],
        weight = 3, opacity = 0.9,
        group = "Track (observed)"
      ) |>
      addPolylines(
        data = TC_ll[TC_ll$DATASET == "forecast", ],
        weight = 3, opacity = 0.8, dashArray = "6,6",
        group = "Track (forecast)"
      ) |>
      addRasterImage(
        hs0_peak_ll, opacity = 0.65,
        colors = pal_hs0p, group = "Hs0 @ peak"
      ) |>
      addRasterImage(
        hs0_max_ll, opacity = 0.65,
        colors = pal_hs0m, group = "Hs0 max (over time)"
      ) |>
      addRasterImage(
        pr_min_ll, opacity = 0.65,
        colors = pal_prp, group = "Pressure @ min"
      ) |>
      addRasterImage(
        pr_min_s_ll, opacity = 0.65,
        colors = pal_prm, group = "Pressure min (over time)"
      ) |>
      addLayersControl(
        overlayGroups = c(
          "Track (observed)", "Track (forecast)",
          "Hs0 @ peak", "Hs0 max (over time)",
          "Pressure @ min", "Pressure min (over time)"
        ),
        options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
      )

    print(m)

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("*Map failed for this storm:* ", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n", sep = "")
  })

  cat("\n\n")
}
```
